exceptions.scope: EasyEDA API boundary, parser pass-through fields, JSON serialization methods, and SVG segment dictionaries
exceptions.rationale: EasyEDA payloads include heterogenous JSON objects and pass-through fields that must preserve source-format data before downstream conversion policy is applied.
exceptions.review: New public structured fields should use typed dataclasses or TypedDicts; the total Any count must not increase without explicit release-note rationale.

exceptions.rule: new code complexity must be A/B
exceptions.rationale: Several parser functions predate the standards repo and encode EasyEDA tilde-delimited grammar branches. The release records the current baseline and blocks growth.
exceptions.review: Parser refactors should split branch-heavy functions and update the baseline only when the offender count or values decrease.

exceptions.rationale: The package already ships from src/py and downstream references use that layout. Moving it during a release-hardening pass would create avoidable churn.
exceptions.review: Consider migrating to src/easyeda_monkey during a dedicated packaging cleanup release.

exceptions.rationale: Current parser code still exposes broad EasyEDA JSON boundary types. This release adds an explicit Pyright config and keeps standard mode while the Any and parser-complexity exceptions are worked down.
exceptions.review: Move toward strict type checking as JSON boundary types and parser branch functions are refined.

exceptions.scope: legacy parser dataclass helper methods such as to_json, from_json, from_fields, and simple properties
exceptions.rationale: The parser modules predate the pydocstyle gate and already have interface-level design documentation. This release enables Ruff with docstyle selected while ignoring the existing repetitive helper-method docstring gaps.
exceptions.review: New public APIs should include useful docstrings. Work down the ignored D102/D107/D415 set as parser modules are refactored.
